comments.text: When brain death is caused by a cardiac arrest, the heart suffers a unique, dual blow. First, it undergoes severe direct damage from the initial heart attack or lack of blood flow that caused the arrest. Because the heart muscle was already failing from the initial cardiac arrest, it has a incredibly difficult time coping with this collapse.
